M2 has m=3, giving about a 3:1 ratio. The output current is 59.7 µA, about 2.99× the 20 µA input.

Because M2 carries 3× the current, its output resistance falls to about 222 kΩ. This makes the rout spec fail too. Restoring m=1 brings the output back to about 19.9 µA. Rout then becomes roughly 3× higher, about 660 kΩ, which passes.
